findings.title: Package terminal pass can precede its selected test execution
findings.impact: The raw stream validator treats package start/pass as sets and checks only test run <= test pass. It therefore accepts an impossible package-completion sequence as valid Native terminal evidence. Source validation must reject this before any later formal acceptance uses the raw interval.
findings.required_fix: Require a single matching start and successful terminal event for each invoked package, and bind every selected test run/pass to that same package interval and event order. Reject package completion before selected tests, duplicate/conflicting terminal events, and unmatched package ownership. Preserve multi-package concurrency by comparing within each package rather than imposing an artificial global event order.
findings.scope_limit: This is an isolated Source validator counterexample. It does not assert that Root current MainNative actually produced this invalid sequence.

remaining_actuals: Full real six routes, GLOBAL, independent formal review, current Root-approved formal capture index and original formal delivery remain OPEN. No Source control creates formal authority.
